notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (product analytics + help center search). Evaluating Hosted API first; looking to move to Dedicated if throughput/costs justify.
- Primary focus: embeddings + semantic search for product docs + user support KB. Must support batch ingestion jobs (nightly) and real-time query embedding lookup.
- Performance targets: sustained 80-120 qps for small queries during business hours; batch embedding job of 100k docs completed within 6-8 hours to meet nightly SLA.
- Vector DB: Oakshore currently evaluating Milvus (self-hosted) and Pinecone (managed). Key ask: clear guidance on integration patterns and best practices for bulk ingestion and partial reindexing.
- Cost sensitivity: conservative — wants predictable unit costs; committed pricing for Dedicated considered if ARR > $60k/yr.
- Model preferences: open/quantized models ok, but wants Redwood-verified performance numbers. Fallback model route for lower-cost inference desirable.
- Security/compliance: strict on SSO (SAML), SOC2 required, audit logs and KMS for key management. Data residency: prefer NA-only for customer data.
- Quote from Head of Product: "We need search quality at scale without surprise bills — predictable latency and simple reindex flows."
- Internal champions: VP Product (Anna Li), Eng Manager (Raj Patel). Procurement lead: Claire Dunne.
- Other notes: they run multiple batch pipelines in Airflow; want CLI + SDK examples for embedding bulk jobs.
- Known risks: internal budget freeze in mid-Q2; vector DB ops experience limited — may prefer Redwood-managed Dedicated to avoid infra lift.
- POC success criteria: 1) embeddings throughput >= 80 qps sustained on real workload, 2) end-to-end ingest->search latency < 150ms for top-1 on 50k doc index, 3) cost estimate for monthly active traffic within target range.
